design_philosophy.description: A sophisticated fusion of 'MasterClass' prestige (Dark Academia) and 'Synthesis.is' modernity (Warm Tech). The design uses a split-screen layout to visually separate but harmoniously connect the institutional/corporate side from the student/parent side.

usage_rules.headings: Use Playfair Display for all major section titles. Italicize key emphasis words for elegance.
usage_rules.body: Use Manrope for all paragraph text. Ensure high readability with relaxed line height.

gradients.gold_text: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-[#d4af37] via-[#fcd34d] to-[#d4af37]

buttons.primary_gold: bg-[#d4af37] text-slate-900 hover:bg-[#bfa030] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-all hover:scale-105 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)]
buttons.primary_amber: bg-amber-500 text-white hover:bg-amber-600 rounded-xl px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-all hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.outline_light: border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-3 transition-all backdrop-blur-sm

cards.academic_glass: bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#d4af37]/20 rounded-none shadow-2xl hover:border-[#d4af37]/40 transition-all duration-500
cards.student_glass: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-300

accordions.style: Use Shadcn Accordion. Customize trigger to have minimal icons. For Academic side, use Gold dividers. For Student side, use soft gray dividers.

inputs.minimal: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 focus:border-white px-0 py-4 text-lg outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-white/40

hero_bg.alt: Abstract geometric gold structure representing mathematics

motion_guidelines.hero_entrance: Fade in up with 0.8s duration, staggered by 0.2s
motion_guidelines.scroll_reveal: Use framer-motion 'whileInView' with viewport margin '-100px'. Opacity 0 to 1, y: 50 to 0.
motion_guidelines.hover_effects: Scale 1.02 on cards. Text color shift on links.
motion_guidelines.parallax: Apply subtle parallax (y: [-20, 20]) to background images.

implementation_steps: 1. Setup Tailwind Theme: Extend colors with 'academic-gold', 'academic-navy', 'student-amber'. Add fonts.
2. Global Styles: Set dark mode as default for body, but override for specific sections.
3. Hero Component: Implement full-height flex container with the geometric background image.
4. Split Section: Create a 2-column grid. Left col = Dark Theme, Right col = Light Theme.
5. Accordions: Customize Shadcn accordion. Left side = Gold borders. Right side = Clean white cards.
6. Contact Form: Use the minimal input style defined in components. Connect to Web3Forms.
7. Footer: Minimalist dark footer with FontAwesome social icons.
universal_guidelines: Ensure 50/50 split is responsive (stacks vertically on mobile).
Use distinct typography: Playfair for prestige, Manrope for utility.
Interactive elements must have a hover state.
All images must be optimized and lazy loaded.
